sentences.text:
After arguing at some length, learned counsel for applicant submits that he is not pressing the instant application for quashing of the proceedings and applicant is willing to appear before the trial Sachin Chaudhary vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53941968/
1 court and a direction may be made to the court concerned to decide the bail application of the applicant in accordance with law laid down in case of Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC 922.

sentences.text: 4. In view of the aforesaid, it is directed that in case, applicant appears/surrenders before the court concerned within a period of two weeks from today and applies for bail, his bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with settled law.

5. It is further directed that for a period of two weeks from today or till the time the applicant appears / surrenders before Court concerned, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the above noted case.
6. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of accordingly.
